desc:
🌙 SURVIVE THE FILIPINO MYTHS: a Filipino horror survival game!

The Aswang, Tikbalang, Kapre and more have taken over the baryo. Pick a class, keep the campfire burning, rescue survivors, fix the jeepney and escape with Mang Tony!

🎮 CONTROLS
- Sprint: Shift
- Shift lock: Ctrl
- Aim: Q | Reload: R
- Bag: B | Map: M
- Drop item: F

💰 Earn Pesos from Daily Quests and every 20th day you survive. Roll for Anting-Anting, Gabay and Agimat blessings!

🔑 Code: STFM2026, 800CCU (join the group to redeem)

⚠️ The game is still in early development, so expect bugs! Report them in our community so we can fix them. Salamat!
